summary: UI test of multi-category shipment pricing (Admin > Envíos create/edit, list label, courier widget, invoice Envío line, Packages Report). Verified working: creating G×1 + B×2 makes the form total $136.00, the list card shows 'G×1 · B×2 - $136.00', the invoice shipping_cost is 136. Edit dialog shows one row per package (G 1×$32, B 2×$52), Costo Total 136.00. Changing pkg2 qty to 1 makes it 84.00; after saving, the list and invoice show 84 and the courier widget is $80 (35+45). Legacy single-category edit shows the single selector and recalculates (A×2=84 → qty3=126 → cat B=156). Packages report counts G and B separately for the multi shipment. No console errors. Found 2 bugs: (1) stale `packages` array after a single-category edit, so the courier widget and report are wrong (HIGH); (2) the default week filter on /admin/shipments never matches the week options, so the list looks empty on load (HIGH, existed before this fix).

critical.issue: Every shipment created with the new form stores packages=[{cat,qty,cost}], even with only 1 package. The edit dialog opens single-package shipments in legacy mode (handleOpenEditDialog uses packages only when length>1). That mode sends shipping_category/package_count/shipping_cost but no packages, so the backend updates the top-level fields and leaves the old packages array as it was. Repro: create a shipment with A×2 ($84). Edit it to B×3: the list and invoice show $156, but DB packages is still [{A,2,84}]. getShipmentParts() prefers packages, so the courier widget, the Packages Report and the courier PDF all use A×2/$84. Seen: widget was $150 instead of $215, and the report showed A 2 paq $84 instead of B 3 paq $156 (report total $168 vs list $240).

ui_bugs.issue: On load the list is always empty ('No hay envíos', widget $0.00) and the week Select shows blank. The initial weekFilter comes from getCurrentWeekKey() (line ~90), which uses Thursday-based keys (e.g. 2026-10-15). The options and filtering at lines ~804 and ~1381 use Monday-noon keys (e.g. 2026-10-19), so the two never match. The user has to pick a week by hand. This existed before this fix (week-cutoff change), but it blocks seeing the shipment just created.

integration_issues.flow: Edit a single-package (new-format) shipment, then view courier widget / Packages Report / PDF
integration_issues.issue: These views use the stale packages array (see backend issue), so they disagree with the list card and the invoice.

issues: Two 'Agregar Paquete' buttons: one adds a category row (edit-add-package), the other adds a tracking field. This is confusing; rename the tracking one to 'Agregar Tracking'.
The helper text under Costo Total says 'Puedes ajustarlo manualmente', but the field is readOnly in multi mode.
The category rows show just the key ('G', 'A', 'B') as the label, not the tenant label.

action_items: Fix the stale packages array. Either (a) in update_shipment, when no data.packages is sent but shipping_category/package_count/shipping_cost changes, rebuild packages as one entry [{category, qty, unit, cost}] (or unset it); or (b) in handleOpenEditDialog, use the multi rows whenever packages.length >= 1 (not >1). Option (a) is safer. Also consider getShipmentParts falling back to top-level fields when packages.length === 1.

Make the AdminShipments default week filter use the same Monday-noon getWeekKey as the options and filtering (lines ~90/105 vs ~804/~1381), so the current week is selected and shows shipments on load.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminShipments.jsx defines 3 different getWeekKey implementations (Thursday-based at top, Monday-noon at ~804 and ~1381). Extract one shared helper.
AdminShipments.jsx is about 2100 lines; split it up (create dialog, list card, courier widget).
The ShipmentEditDialog multi-row total is computed in a useEffect keyed on JSON.stringify(packages). It works, but useMemo plus a derived value would avoid extra renders.

rca of the issue: Stale packages: the create endpoint always stores packages, even for 1 package. The edit UI treats length<=1 as legacy and sends no packages. The PUT handler only rewrites packages when data.packages is provided, and getShipmentParts trusts packages whenever length>0. Week filter: commit f6f988f changed the week cutoff, but the initial-state getCurrentWeekKey stayed Thursday-based.
